name: block-faq
use: Questions and answers at the end of a page; search engines read them as FAQPage structured data.
avoid: Anywhere but the end of a page; answers with markdown marks (they go into structured data verbatim).
props: { kind: 'block-faq'; title: string; items: { q: string; a: string }[] }

cases.title: Questions a buyer asks before signing up
cases.why: Answers the doubts that remain after the page, and search engines show them as answers.

items.q: Do I need a credit card?
items.a: No. You can start without one.

docs: npx shadcn add @fractera/block-faq. In a page: { "kind": "block-faq", "title": "…", "items": [ { "q": "…", "a": "…" } ] } as the last block.
